title: New PHI Air Medical base expected to open in Weatherford, spring 2027
summary: The base is expected to open in spring 2027 and will operate a Bell 407 helicopter.
body_markdown:
[PHI Air Medical](https://bit.ly/ParkerAirMed) and[Parker County Hospital District (PCHD) Emergency Medical Services](https://www.pchdtx.gov/p/departments/pchd-ems) announced a new partnership that will establish an air medical base in Parker County, expanding access to emergency air transport for patients across the county and surrounding North Texas communities.


The base is expected to open in spring 2027 and will operate a Bell[407](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407) helicopter.


Through the partnership, PHI Air Medical will provide the aircraft, pilots, mechanics, aviation operations, communications, and dispatch support.


Parker County Hospital District will provide the medical crew, medical direction, and medical supplies, combining local clinical expertise with PHI’s air medical aviation capabilities.


The aircraft will support emergency scene responses and interfacility transports for critically ill and injured patients who require timely access to trauma, specialty, or higher-level care.


The location will establish PHI Air Medical’s first base west of Fort Worth and provide an additional resource for local emergency medical services (EMS) agencies, hospitals, and healthcare providers.


Randy Bacus, CEO at Parker County Hospital District, commented: “This partnership with PHI Air Medical will bring an important new air medical resource to the residents and growing communities we serve. A Parker County-based aircraft will complement our existing ground EMS capabilities and strengthen the network of care available to patients throughout the region. Our team looks forward to working alongside PHI Air Medical and opening the new base in spring 2027.”


“Strong local partnerships are essential to delivering timely access to critical care,” said Paul Julander, co-president of PHI Health.


“By combining Parker County Hospital District’s local clinical expertise with PHI’s aviation capabilities, we are strengthening support for emergency responders and healthcare providers across North Texas. Together, we are committed to ensuring communities have access to specialized air medical services when every moment matters.”


To learn more about PHI Air Medical and its services, please visit[www.phiairmedical.com](https://bit.ly/ParkerAirMed) .
